levels.ZERO_IMPORTER: no source file imports it at all (not even its own package's __init__)
levels.PACKAGE_INTERNAL_ONLY: imported only by a sibling in its OWN package directory; nothing outside the package imports it -- the module is reachable but NOT wired
levels.EXTERNALLY_CONSUMED: imported by at least one file outside its own package directory

method: For every non-test source file, count the non-test source files that import it. A basename match outside the module's own file counts as an importer, so the sweep UNDER-reports orphans (the safe direction).
